unit: WF4 Approval Gate returns INVALID for an unrecognised decision string and never SENDs
description: A well-formed APPROVE-shaped context carrying an unrecognised decision string must return gate INVALID with the decision named, and must never return gate SEND.
why_it_exists: Gate check step 6 of wf4/approval-gate.js whitelists APPROVE, APPROVE_LINK, REJECT, REQUEST_EDIT and REQUEST_MORE_INFORMATION; anything else is refused as INVALID. The delivery-key families only ever drove APPROVE, so an out-of-set decision was unasserted. This pins that an unrecognised decision cannot be coerced into a send even when every other check has passed.

drafts.content: Our client requires the vehicle inspection report referred to in your letter of 14 January.

expect.note: Every structural check passes and the delivery identity IS derived, but the decision string is out of the whitelist, so the gate is INVALID, never SEND.

assertions: an unrecognised decision string returns gate INVALID
the refusal names the offending decision so the owner sees exactly what was rejected
the delivery identity is derived (fields present) but is never turned into a SEND
dry_run is normalised to the boolean true and passed through on the refusal
Config keys survive the refusal untouched
